messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning:
The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles (California) that stay open until at least 10pm. Also want vegan restaurants in San Francisco (California) and Seattle (Washington). They didn't specify operating hours for SF and Seattle; maybe we can use default 21? But they might want same criteria? The prompt says "It should find vegan restaurants in LA that stay open until at least 10pm, and also find vegan restaurants in SF and Seattle." It doesn't say operating hours for SF/Seattle. We could ask clarifying question: do they want same operating hours for all? Or just LA? The user said "它們至少要營業到晚上10點" which refers to "they" presumably all three cities? Actually Chinese: "它們至少要營業到晚上10點" means "They must stay open until at least 10pm". That likely applies to all three locations. So we need to find vegan restaurants in LA, SF, Seattle that stay open until at least 10pm.

We have a function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby with location and optional operating_hours. We'll call it thrice: one for each city. For each call, we set operating_hours=22 (since 10pm is 22 in 24h). The function returns data. Then we present results.

We need to call the function. Use the function name vegan_restaurant_find_nearby with arguments: location: "Los Angeles, CA", operating_hours: 22. Then again for "San Francisco, CA", operating_hours: 22. Then for "Seattle, WA", operating_hours: 22.

We'll produce separate calls.
